name: Girish Chowdhary
title: Professor
department: Agricultural and Biological Engineering; Siebel School of Computing and Data Science; Coordinated Science Laboratory
fitReason: HyReach (2026) combines MASt3R reconstruction, open-vocabulary object localization, shape-aware planning and a learned hybrid-arm controller. AFIL (2026) studies failure-informed guidance of VLA policies, providing a separate foundation-policy learning direction.

physicalEvidence.summary: HyReach explicitly evaluates a physical6DoF rigid arm carrying a three-actuator soft continuum segment and tip RGB camera across four obstacle/clutter/hole configurations. Its neural controller is trained on9,536 physical pose-actuation samples. AFIL’s VLA evaluations are simulation and do not supply additional hardware evidence.

name: Rebecca Kramer-Bottiglio
title: Professor
fitReason: CableRobotGraphSim (2026) learns tensegrity dynamics from physical trajectories and simulation with graph neural networks. This offers a focused CS-oriented dynamics/model-learning fit within a broader soft-robotics and materials lab.

physicalEvidence.summary: The2026 learning study uses nine trajectories from a real three-bar tensegrity robot; its learned MPPI maze/navigation experiments are on a simulated six-bar system. An older IROS2023 study provides explicit learned-simulator locomotion transfer to physical three-bar hardware. The2026 Tribar publication separately establishes recent physical autonomous locomotion, not necessarily learned control.

shortVisit.summary: The lab’s current undergraduate/MS notice says it is moving to Princeton and asks readers to check back about AY2026–27 opportunities. This is not a current invitation to external short-term master’s visitors. Princeton’s institutional VSRC route alone earns no opportunity points.

scoreReasons.fit: Concrete GNN dynamics/sim-to-real fit, narrower than generalist robot-policy labs.
scoreReasons.physical: Recent real dynamics data and autonomous robot evidence; learned hardware-control transfer anchor is older and new-campus equipment unknown.
scoreReasons.shortVisit: No external short-visit invitation; check-back notice and central policy do not establish acceptance.
